name: spritemake-generation-choice
purpose: Ask whether the user wants keyless Codex direct generation, strict external gpt-image-2 generation, or setup-only SpriteMake scaffolding.

choices.label: Codex direct generation
choices.meaning: Create the SpriteMake batch and use Codex's built-in image generation without API keys; model selection is not user-selectable or verified as gpt-image-2.

choices.label: Strict gpt-image-2 external generation
choices.meaning: Create the gpt-image-2 prompt; the user must paste it into ChatGPT web or another external generation environment.

choices.label: Codex setup only
choices.meaning: Create folders, markdown request docs, gpt-image-2 prompt, manifest, QA, and preview tool; do not generate the image.

note: This documents the desired prompt-time behavior for SpriteMake agents. Codex must follow AGENTS.md or call this hook; this file alone does not make the Codex runtime execute hooks automatically.
